q1.p1.text.value: Find the load the large piston carries when the small one is pressed with force $f$.

q1.solution.value: The pressure is the same in both, so the load is $F = f A / a$.

q1.text.value:
A hydraulic scale has two pistons joined by oil, the small one of area $a$ and the
large one of area $A$.
